purpose: Test whether the three positional O0 conditional coefficient-drift candidates survive conversion to semantically symmetric signed differences.

representation.reason_strength_excluded: strength is the exact mean of the six signed differences and would create perfect linear dependence if included with all six differences
representation.semantic_rule: positive means Team A exceeds Team B on the corresponding metric

method.model: multivariate logistic regression over all six signed differences
method.standardization: fit separately within each early/late half
method.support: 500 bootstrap development-era resamples using only rows 0:1952

interpretation: The three previously identified positional candidates survive conversion to semantically symmetric signed representations. Their conditional coefficient drift is therefore not explained away by Team A/Team B positional coding alone. This does not yet prove causal or production usefulness; it only validates the structural drift signal.

decision.next_step: Freeze a minimal, symmetric, three-component temporal-drift hypothesis only after pre-registering its exact parameterization and chronological evaluation protocol. Do not tune against the untouched test or future holdout.
